text_description: Full-length runway look built around a long, dark chocolate-brown outer coat with a straight, slightly relaxed column silhouette, falling from the shoulders to near the ankles and worn open through the lower front. The coat has a dramatic oversized shawl-style collar/lapel in plush warm brown pile, framing the neck and chest in a deep V shape over a black high-neck underlayer. The main coat body appears smooth and matte-to-subtly lustrous, with dark long sleeves and the model’s hands set into side pockets, reinforcing a wrapped, insulated outerwear mood. At the lower center front, a loose metallic chain detail hangs vertically from the coat opening around the waist/hip area. Beneath the coat is a black, floor-grazing dress or skirt layer with visible cascading ruffles, lace-like or netted texture, and irregular fluttering edges that extend below the coat hem and move around the ankles. The palette is almost entirely dark brown and black, contrasted by the warmer brown plush collar. Styling is minimal and severe: no visible jewelry beyond the chain detail, close-cropped hair, and black footwear peeking from under the ruffled hem, appearing as dark boots or shoes with a sturdy runway sole. Overall the look reads as dramatic fall outerwear layered over a textured black evening skirt/dress, combining heavy protective volume at the top with fluid, distressed-looking ruffle movement at the hem.
key_elements: oversized warm brown plush shawl collar
loose metallic chain hanging at front waist
black ruffled floor-length skirt or dress layer
dark boots or shoes visible under hem
uncertainty_notes: Plush collar could be fur or faux fur; material is not confirmable from the image.
Underlayer may be a dress or separate top and skirt, but only the visible layering is clear.
Footwear details are mostly obscured by the long ruffled hem.
